text.p: These are the leading stories in the Namibian press on Thursday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- President Sam Nujoma signalled his intention to stand for a third term in office, telling parliament that at 67 years old he was still young enough to do the job, should the people need his services.
- Nujoma said in his state of the nation address to parliament that Namibia was in a healthy state, but needed continuous work to ensure it did not fall into ruin.
- Nujoma ignored pressing issues such as land reform in his state of the nation address, and blamed negative developments on outside influences.
